preDeclaredBar.text: Publish-worthy only if, walk-forward, (1) model MAE is at least 15% lower than the category-mean baseline with a season-clustered 95% bootstrap interval that excludes zero, and (2) the stated 80% range holds between 72% and 88% of outcomes.
